name: deep-research
description: Run a multi-stage read-only research workflow that scopes a question, maps evidence, synthesizes findings, and reviews uncertainty.

stages.name: research-brief
prompt: Create a concise research brief from input.intent and input.research.
Define the research question, audience, scope boundaries, assumptions, and decision criteria.
List what evidence would be needed for a confident answer. Do not claim live facts unless available in the provided context or tools.

stages.name: source-map
prompt: Read input.briefFile, then map the available evidence for this research task.
Use repository files, supplied material, and available tools when feasible. Distinguish direct evidence, inference, and unknowns.
Return Markdown with evidence categories, source paths or source descriptions, confidence notes, and gaps.

stages.name: synthesize-report
prompt: Read input.briefFile and input.sourceMapFile, then write a deep research report for input.intent.
Include executive summary, key findings, comparisons or trade-offs, evidence quality, open questions, and recommended next steps.
Separate confirmed facts from assumptions and mark time-sensitive claims that need live verification.

stages.name: review-research
prompt: Review input.reportFile for unsupported claims, missing counterpoints, stale assumptions, and unclear recommendations.
Return a short Markdown review with pass/fail recommendation, concrete improvements, and remaining uncertainty.
